passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I am a girl, and my name is Mina.
phrases.py: wǒ shì nǚ hái， wǒ jiào mǐ nà。

phrases.en: I am thirteen years old, and I am in the sixth grade.
phrases.py: wǒ shí sān suì， shàng liù nián jí。

phrases.en: I want to be a kind girl at school and at home.
phrases.ko: 나는 학교와 집에서 친절한 아이가 되고 싶어요.
phrases.zh: 我想在学校和家里都做个善良的女孩。
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng zài xué xiào hé jiā lǐ dōu zuò gè shàn liáng de nǚ hái。

phrases.en: I smile when I meet my friends.
phrases.py: wǒ jiàn dào péng yǒu jiù huì xiào。

phrases.en: I like to help my friends when they need me.
phrases.zh: 朋友需要我的时候，我喜欢帮助他们。
phrases.py: péng yǒu xū yào wǒ de shí hòu， wǒ xǐ huān bāng zhù tā men。

phrases.en: I am happy when we play together.
phrases.zh: 我们一起玩的时候，我很快乐。
phrases.py: wǒ men yì qǐ wán de shí hòu， wǒ hěn kuài lè。

phrases.en: I am not very tall, but I can run fast.
phrases.ko: 나는 키가 아주 크지는 않지만, 빨리 달릴 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 我个子不太高，可是跑得很快。
phrases.py: wǒ gè zi bù tài gāo， kě shì pǎo de hěn kuài。

phrases.en: I want to be brave when something is hard.
phrases.zh: 事情很难的时候，我想变得勇敢。
phrases.py: shì qíng hěn nán de shí hòu， wǒ xiǎng biàn de yǒng gǎn。

phrases.en: I help my little sister because she is younger than me.
phrases.zh: 妹妹比我小，所以我帮助她。
phrases.py: mèi mèi bǐ wǒ xiǎo， suǒ yǐ wǒ bāng zhù tā。

phrases.en: My friends say that I am kind and happy.
phrases.zh: 朋友们说我又善良又快乐。
phrases.py: péng yǒu men shuō wǒ yòu shàn liáng yòu kuài lè。

phrases.en: I like myself, and I want to grow a little every day.
phrases.ko: 나는 나 자신을 좋아하고, 매일 조금씩 자라고 싶어요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢我自己，也想每天长大一点点。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān wǒ zì jǐ， yě xiǎng měi tiān zhǎng dà yì diǎn diǎn。

full_passage_spoken: I am a girl, and my name is Mina. I am thirteen years old, and I am in the sixth grade. I want to be a kind girl at school and at home. I smile when I meet my friends. I like to help my friends when they need me. I am happy when we play together. I am not very tall, but I can run fast. I want to be brave when something is hard. I help my little sister because she is younger than me. My friends say that I am kind and happy. I like myself, and I want to grow a little every day.
full_passage_zh: 我是女孩，我叫米娜。我十三岁，上六年级。我想在学校和家里都做个善良的女孩。我见到朋友就会笑。朋友需要我的时候，我喜欢帮助他们。我们一起玩的时候，我很快乐。我个子不太高，可是跑得很快。事情很难的时候，我想变得勇敢。妹妹比我小，所以我帮助她。朋友们说我又善良又快乐。我喜欢我自己，也想每天长大一点点。
